references.text: Mentions the Shihor River as a border toward Egypt, the same geographical reference as in Joshua 13:3
Ekron is mentioned as a border city, the same city referred to in Joshua 13:3
Mentions the five Philistine rulers that Israel did not drive out, the same five rulers as in Joshua 13:3
Lists the same five Philistine rulers: Gaza, Ashdod, Ashkelon, Gath, and Ekron
Confirms the five Philistine cities: Ashdod, Gaza, Ashkelon, Gath, and Ekron
Mentions the Avvites who lived in villages near Gaza, the same people group as in Joshua 13:3
Prophesies against Ekron and the remnant of the Philistines, the same area as in Joshua 13:3
Mentions Ashdod and Ashkelon in judgment against the Philistines, two of the five cities in Joshua 13:3
Prophesies against the four Philistine cities Ashkelon, Gaza, Ekron, and Ashdod, and notes that Ekron will become like the Avvites
